### Read and format data
```{r reading_data}

reference <- LoadH5Seurat("Exported_h5seurat_files/pbmc_multimodal_CD8_cells_only.h5seurat")
HNSCC.data <- readRDS("Data/HNSCC_seurat.rds")

```


### Project onto ref
```{r project_onto_ref}

DefaultAssay(reference) <- "SCT"

DefaultAssay(HNSCC.data) <- "integrated"


# recalculating reference UMAP

DefaultAssay(reference) <- 'SCT'
reference <- SCTransform(reference, verbose = FALSE, assay = "SCT")


reference <- 
  NormalizeData(reference) %>% 
  FindVariableFeatures() %>% 
  ScaleData() %>% 
  RunPCA()

DefaultAssay(reference) <- 'ADT'

# we will use all ADT features for dimensional reduction
# we set a dimensional reduction name to avoid overwriting the 
VariableFeatures(reference) <- rownames(reference[["ADT"]])

reference <- 
  NormalizeData(reference, 
               normalization.method = 'CLR', 
               margin = 2) %>% 
  ScaleData() %>% 
  RunPCA(reduction.name = 'apca')


# Identify multimodal neighbors. These will be stored in the neighbors slot, 
# and can be accessed using bm[['weighted.nn']]
# The WNN graph can be accessed at bm[["wknn"]], 
# and the SNN graph used for clustering at bm[["wsnn"]]
# Cell-specific modality weights can be accessed at bm$RNA.weight
reference <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(reference, 
                                     reduction.list = list("pca", "apca"), 
                                     dims.list = list(1:30, 1:18), 
                                     modality.weight.name = "Multi.weight")


reference <- RunSPCA(reference, 
                     assay = 'SCT',
                     graph = 'wsnn')

reference <- RunUMAP(reference,
                     reduction = 'spca', 
                     dims = 1:50)




#FindClusters(reference, graph.name = "wsnn", algorithm = 3, resolution = 2, verbose = FALSE)



#reference <- ScaleData(reference, assay = 'SCT')



reference@meta.data

DimPlot(reference, group.by = "donor", reduction = "umap") 
DimPlot(reference, group.by = "celltype.l2", reduction = "umap") 







# normalise dataset to match reference 
HNSCC.data <- SCTransform(HNSCC.data, verbose = FALSE)

HNSCC.data







dataset.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = reference,
                                       query = HNSCC.data,
                                       normalization.method = "SCT",
                                       reference.reduction = "spca",
                                       dims = 1:50)



HNSCC.data <- MapQuery(anchorset = dataset.anchors,
                       query = HNSCC.data,
                       reference = reference,
                       refdata = list(
                         celltype.l1 = "celltype.l1",
                         celltype.l2 = "celltype.l2",
                         celltype.l3 = "celltype.l3",
                         predicted_ADT = "ADT"
                       ),
                       reference.reduction = "spca", 
                       reduction.model = "umap")#wnn.umap




p1 = DimPlot(HNSCC.data, reduction = "ref.umap", group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2", label = TRUE, label.size = 3, repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()
p2 = DimPlot(HNSCC.data, reduction = "ref.umap", group.by = "predicted.celltype.l3", label = TRUE, label.size = 3 ,repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()
p1 + p2






# Compute new UMAP visualisation

reference$id <- 'reference'
HNSCC.data$id <- 'query'
refquery <- merge(reference, HNSCC.data)
refquery[["spca"]] <- merge(reference[["spca"]], HNSCC.data[["ref.spca"]])
refquery <- RunUMAP(refquery, reduction = 'spca', dims = 1:50)

DimPlot(refquery, 
        group.by = 'id', 
        shuffle = TRUE)



head(refquery@meta.data)



DimPlot(refquery, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, label.size = 3 ,repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()

DimPlot(refquery, reduction = "umap", group.by = "predicted.celltype.l3", label = TRUE, label.size = 3 ,repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()





















predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = dataset.anchors,
                            refdata = Bai.seurat$seurat_clusters, 
                            dims = 1:30)



Bald.seurat <- AddMetaData(Bald.seurat,
                              metadata = predictions)




Bai.seurat <- RunUMAP(Bai.seurat, 
                      dims = 1:30,
                      reduction = "pca",
                      return.model = TRUE)


Bald.seurat <- MapQuery(anchorset = dataset.anchors,
                           reference = Bai.seurat,
                           query = Bald.seurat, 
                           refdata = list(celltype = "celltype"),
                           reference.reduction = "pca", 
                           reduction.model = "umap")



p1 <- DimPlot(Bai.seurat, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              group.by = "celltype",
              label = TRUE, 
              label.size = 3, 
    repel = TRUE) + 
  NoLegend() + 
  ggtitle("Reference annotations")

p2 <- DimPlot(Bald.seurat,
              reduction = "ref.umap", 
              group.by = "seurat_clusters",
              label = TRUE, 
    label.size = 3,
    repel = TRUE) + 
  NoLegend() + 
  ggtitle("Query transferred labels")


p1 + p2

Bald.seurat@meta.data



```
